plugin.name: English only
plugin.description: Your game runs in English. The English text is part of the core files; nothing else is installed.

plugin.name: French (Français)
plugin.description: Your game runs in French. Installs Interface\Translations\LostArt_FRENCH.txt, which Skyrim needs to show this mod's text in a French game. Where no translation has shipped yet, this file carries the English text.
